build_habitat_simulator: build a python module to load a Habitat simulator from a scene path with robust navmesh fallback
create_habitat_configuration: create a Habitat simulator configuration for a given scene path with optional depth sensor
convert_heading_to_quaternion: convert a heading angle in degrees to a quaternion for 3D navigation orientation
filter_scene_files: filter a list of scene file paths against a whitelist of valid scene names
generate_topdown_map: generate a top-down occupancy map from a Habitat pathfinder at a given height and resolution
